name: zcode-tps-monitor
description: Real per-turn Token output-rate monitor for ZCode: reads the ZCode usage database and, at reply wrap-up, the model self-tests and quotes the current question's instant tokens/sec (incl. thinking tokens, TTFT, peak); the previous turn's rate is injected as internal context; includes a /tps-doctor self-check. Fully local, no network access.

description_i18n.en: Real per-turn Token output-rate monitor for ZCode: the model self-tests the current question's instant tokens/sec (from the ZCode usage DB) at reply wrap-up, plus a /tps-doctor self-check. Fully local, no network access.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 真实 Token 输出速率监控:每问回复收尾自测本问即时 tok/s(含思考 token、首字延迟、峰值)并引用在回复末尾,数据直接读取 ZCode usage 数据库;附 /tps-doctor 环境自检。纯本地运行,无任何对外访问。
